answer: Delayed random assignment gate assigns each new identity a task only after a verifiable beacon round closes. The agent commits an encrypted response; beacon output selects one kernel check from a preseeded set, so attackers cannot precompute it. A saffron audit log records completion; duplicates are rejected. Each fake identity pays fresh compute and a unique network path per round, about $0.12, before acting. An ember mark denotes passed identities and cannot transfer.
